scripts.verify:packages: bun run build:packages && bun run test:packages
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run typecheck:workspace
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names web,docs "bun scripts/alchemy-dev.ts dev" "bun --filter @netscry/docs dev"
scripts.dev:web: bun run build:packages && bun scripts/alchemy-dev.ts dev
scripts.check: bun run build:packages && bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names code,docs "bun run check:code" "bun run check:docs"
scripts.check:code: ultracite check apps packages scripts tests/e2e playwright.config.ts alchemy.run.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check:docs: bun --filter @netscry/docs check && bun --filter @netscry/docs doctor && bun --filter @netscry/docs validate
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run test:packages && bun run test:unit
